  WHY: The guard may fall back to the session checkout instead of the worktree Git directory, causing an incorrect verdict; the reviewer reports this case is not covered by the quoted-tilde regression test.

  PROBLEM: A segment beginning with `then`, `do`, or `else` that contains `git push` is skipped because its executable is not `git`.
  WHY: A Git push inside an `if/then` or `while/do` block may run in a changed directory without being judged, bypassing the guard.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_evaluate_bash` (the `judged: set[GuardTarget] = set()` dedup + the `guard_targets` iterator) | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]

  WHY: The reviewer reports that a second commit in the same command can be dropped after an earlier equivalent target is evaluated; the current tests do not exercise this case.
